headline: Onboards strategic investor Blackstone; strengthens capital base

highlights: Per (%) -7/32/21 12M Avg Val (INR M) 1401 Financials &Valuations (INR b) Y/E March FY26 FY27E FY28E NII 60.4 90.9 112.5 Total Income 76.6 101.7 123.8 PPoP 41.5 60.4 74.7 PAT (pre-NCI) 18.2 36.3 45.1 PAT (post-NCI) 16.6 34.5 42.7 EPS (INR) 39.1 81.1 80.2 EPS Gr.

The company intends to utilise the capital to accelerate growth in its gold finance business and expand its secured lending franchises. ◼ We view the event as a positive development, since it addresses a key balance-sheet constraint and will provide the company with substantial growth capital at a time when it is looking to scale its secured lending franchises.
The participation of Blackstone, a large global private equity investor, also provides a strong institutional endorsement of the franchise and could improve the company's access to funding over time.

Importantly, the promoters' participation through warrants, along with Blackstone, demonstrates continued confidence in the business and aligns their interests with the new investor. ◼ We raise our FY27/FY28 EPS estimates by 7%/11% to factor in this equity infusion into the company.
